aiReviewer: GPT-6 (AI editorial review; no human review)
reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial pass over 38 original low-typing questions: reviewed each full German sentence, all four options, morphological forms, intended sense, bilingual feedback, hints and distinct scenarios. Nineteen sources authored; gerecht deferred due objective overlap with existing fair target. Corrected inherited misleading glosses for gemütlich, gewiss and other sense distinctions. No independent human approval, CEFR certification or rights clearance. All reviews pending; publicationApproved=false.
